# UNESCO

> UNESCO builds peace through education, science, culture, and communication by fostering international cooperation on sustainable development, world heritage preservation, and global challenges.

UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization that coordinates international efforts in education, natural and social sciences, culture, and communication. The organization works through governing bodies, partnerships, and global initiatives to address pressing issues like climate change, gender equality, and cultural preservation.

## Key Topics

- Education, Science, and Culture
- World Heritage
- Sustainable Development
- UNESCO Mission

## Core Mission & Governance

- [UNESCO Homepage](https://www.unesco.org/en): UNESCO homepage defining organization's mission in education, science, culture and peace-building.
- [Governance](https://www.unesco.org/en/governance): UNESCO governance structure and leadership roles ensuring organizational accountability.
- [Partnerships](https://www.unesco.org/en/partnerships): UNESCO partnerships with governments, NGOs and private sector for collaborative initiatives.

## Events & Meetings

- [Calendar of Events](https://www.unesco.org/en/events): UNESCO events calendar featuring international activities and cultural events worldwide.
- [Governing Bodies](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/governing-bodies): UNESCO governing bodies including General Conference and Executive Board meetings.
- [Statutory Meetings](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/statutory-meetings): UNESCO statutory meetings and expert committees for governance and policy decisions.
- [Cultural Events at Headquarters](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/cultural): UNESCO headquarters cultural events including exhibitions, concerts and performances.
- [Commemorations and Celebrations](https://www.unesco.org/en/commemorations): UNESCO commemorations and international observances promoting cultural and scientific awareness.

## News & Impact Stories

- [Newsroom](https://www.unesco.org/en/newsroom): UNESCO newsroom with press releases and media resources on global education and culture work.
- [UNESCO Stories](https://www.unesco.org/en/stories): UNESCO impact stories and human-interest features from global education and culture programs.
